title: Infrakit's COO calls it 'the best business book I've read in the last few years' — then applies 'it's always too early until it's too late' to construction
summary: Frost is COO at Infrakit, which sells software to infrastructure contractors. He took the principle Eric applies to locking in a company's mission before money pressure wins, and used it on the decision contractors defer every time: whether to put new software on a job already running.
blockquote: Incorruptible by Eric Ries is the best business book I've read in the last few years. One of his principles has always stuck with me: "it's always too early until it's too late."
